external_sources.description: Issuer names a successor and a conversion deadline; a policy assertion, not execution or entitlement evidence.

Public first-party FAQ application data says post-IPO conversion can be onchain without KYC. It also describes offchain arbitrage; it supplies no concrete audited conversion instruction in this captured source.

2025-08-07 issuer newsletter distinguishes KYC-gated mint/redemption from ordinary trading. General historical communication does not establish this holder eligibility or a currently functioning redemption flow.
Original external lifecycle policy and hypothetical semantic boundary remain unchanged; successor field remains null in that policy.

issuer_semantics.holder_action: Issuer notice instructs holders to swap source tokens into SPCXx or any other token before its deadline.
issuer_semantics.successor_reference: Issuer notice links Xs3oZwbHvqis4NYcf4YKWmEia2eC84wSiVrcYcTqpH8; separately verified current on-chain bytes do not by themselves prove issuer endorsement.
issuer_semantics.conversion_description: Public FAQ describes post-IPO conversion into equivalent tokenized public stock; neither captured notice nor FAQ specifies a conversion program, instruction, account plan, fixed ratio or completion receipt.
issuer_semantics.kyc_conversion_claim: Captured FAQ describes post-IPO conversion as fully onchain without KYC. Historical launch material treats minting/redemption separately; no conversion-specific KYC dependency is established.
issuer_semantics.deadline_claim: Issuer SpaceX notice: 11:59pm UTC on 12 March 2027. Original hypothetical Phase 4 policy time/boundary are preserved separately.

stop_condition: C: bounded public mechanism reconstruction completed; no independently bound executable official conversion plan established. Stop without a substitute transaction.
